candidate_program.name: weighted_overlap_margin
candidate_program.rationale: Uses weighted mutual exclusion among active rivals to estimate displaced reward, then scores a signed root margin with a small sparsity bonus. The approximation is local; weighted induced-edge work can be quadratic.
candidate_program.rule: weight - max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / (1 + 2 * overlap_mass / (1 + conflict_weight))) + 0.05 * weight / (1 + degree)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
